{{Tag info
| title = Polychrome Tag

| ante = Any
| unlock = Discover the {{edition|Polychrome}} edition
}}
The '''Polychrome Tag''' is a [[Tag]] that can be acquired either by skipping a {{Blind|Small Blind}} or a {{Blind|Big Blind}}. This tag starts to appear at [[Ante 1]].

Acquiring this tag would make the next base edition [[Jokers|Joker]], found in [[The Shop]], have a {{Edition|Polychrome}} edition instead. It would also cost {{money|0}} instead of its original cost.
